notes.title: Games That Change You
notes.notes: [p]Dearest mortals, [/p][p]We just got back from the [url="https://www.gamespress.com/en-US/Games-for-Change-Announces-2025-Award-Winners"]Games for Change Awards[/url], and we couldn't be more delighted to share that not only did we take home the award for [b]Best in Health and Wellness[/b], our dear friends at [url="https://www.torporgames.com/"]Torpor Games[/url] also took home the [b]Best in Civics[/b] award! Here in Berlin, we're lucky enough to make games that challenge, which is why we want to direct you to another game where you'll learn more about the world around you. [/p][p][/p][carousel][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44838963/f35a9cf3e34745acc47c904b3ad5184a6ca768a5.jpg"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44838963/bb7360b215ac668302444412b5b90dece9a15de0.jpg"][/img][/carousel][p]Now that you’ve figured yourself out in [i]Vampire Therapist[/i], solving geopolitical issues should be as easy as blood pie! Thankfully our friends at fellow Berlin studio [b]Torpor Games[/b] have got just the sort of in-depth, clever sort of game you’re into! After all, aren't politicians just people in severe psychological distress?[/p][p]If you’ve ever craved a story full of complex characters and tough choices where every decision truly matters, [i]Suzerain[/i] is definitely the game to test your moral compass. In the original campaign, you step into the shoes of President Anton Rayne, navigating the stormy waters of Sordland’s fragile democracy: think Cold War tensions, economic disaster, and the exact sprinkle of good ol’ corruption, enough to turn your cabinet meetings into passive-aggressive showdowns. [/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44838963/482696497132a0cfc55ada378ae6e21de8cc8c39.png"][/img][/p][p]With the award-winning [i]Suzerain: Kingdom of Rizia[/i], their first DLC, Torpor Games raises the stakes (not the wooden ones). This time you rule as King Romus Toras, newly crowned leader of the Kingdom of Rizia, who must maintain power amidst anti-monarchist uprising and court gossip. So if you need a break from the therapist’s couch, why not take a detour into the presidential office or the throne room? Just... don’t expect inner peace there either. [/p][p]Oh, did we mention all our games are on sale right now? Buy a friend a copy and spark some interesting conversations![/p][p]Until next time, children of the night! [/p][p][/p][p]Rest in peace, [/p][p]The Little Bat Games Team[/p]

notes.title: Vampire Therapist up for two more awards!
notes.notes:
Greetings dear mortals,

Just a mini-update from your friends at Little Bat Games! We've been having an exciting and overwhelming awards season. It's incredible to see the critical response to Vampire Therapist and has given us a lot of confidence to double down on our game development process here.

[h2]Awards Season Highlights[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44838963/e5213c145bb5ff116d996d5e2046aa8e9017ef05.jpg[/img]

Just a few weeks ago, we picked up the German Computer Games Prize for Best Story during a wild awards show night. It turns out that the German game development scene is as wacky as we are!

Now we're up for a [url=https://festival.gamesforchange.org/]Games for Change award[/url] in the Health & Wellness category. Players have been telling us how meaningful Vampire Therapist has been for them, and we're thrilled we get to show our stuff to a different crowd. The awards will be streamed on June 26th from the Parsons School of Design in New York. [url=https://festival.gamesforchange.org/]Check out the stream[/url] at 6:30pm ET if you'd like to follow along !

Then on the 9th of July, we'll be up for a [url=https://www.developconference.com/awards]Develop:Star award[/url] for Best Original IP! We like our IP quite well and if someone from Netflix would like to get in touch, we'll talk. 

If you missed it, we also picked up a Qweerty Queer Gaming Excellence Award! We're absolutely honored that our message of self-acceptance was seen.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44838963/9e4e0a6d7322248cce9e27a245f3b93740a17e7c.jpg[/img]

[h2]Okay, okay, I don't care about stupid awards[/h2]
Geez, okay, we just wanted to share some moments that made us proud, but okay, we get it. 

We have gone into production on our next game and we couldn't be more excited! This is the fun part for us: making blisteringly unique characters, talking to the top academics in the world, and finding the perfect voices are what we've been focusing on. We're not ready to reveal what we're up to yet, but you can expect the same viciously playful humor and historical psychology approach. And there will be a returning client from Vampire Therapist. It's not Edmund.

Thank you all for supporting us and helping us get to this place! Keep telling your friends about Vampire Therapist, and if they make a grossed-out face, be patient. They will be ready for therapy when they are ready, as Andromachos might say.

Until next time, pardners, stay cozy in your coffins and if you have a horse, tell them you love them. 🐎

Love,
Little Bat Games

notes.title: Vampire Therapist Digital Art Book Now Available
notes.notes:
Dearest mortals,

We just got back from our trip to the BAFTAs last week, which was quite a surprise for a small game like ours! Seeing our little Vampire Therapist up there with excellent titles like Tales of Kenzera: Zau, Kind Words 2, Senua's Saga 2, Botany Manor, and Tetris Forever will stick with us for a while, and we met some incredible people. Our art director even got to take a picture with Astarion, but she's German so we won't share her pics here.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44838963/69db3efcb6d2e9980e3b7bde135997c1f1d8ecf3.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44838963/ea5b381d4d0c774b8d2c3f557583d0f8022be9da.jpg[/img]

Although we didn't bring home the award, we brought something to share with you all!

[h1]Art Book[/h1]

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3643880/Vampire_Therapist__Digital_Art_Book][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44838963/7e7aac6610440fd833b5433aa8255f34693856fc.png[/img][/url]

The [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3643880/Vampire_Therapist__Digital_Art_Book]Vampire Therapist art book is here[/url]! 97 pages of bloody good concept art and behind the scenes tidbits from the Little Bat Games team. We're honored people care enough to even want something like this, and we're eternally grateful for your support. Literally.

[h1]What's Next?[/h1]

We're hard at work on our next game already. It's sure to be something entirely unexpected, but with the same focus on comedy and history you've come to expect from us. We're uncovering old mysteries, and have enlisted the help of top academics from around the world to tell our next tale. While in England for the BAFTAs, we stopped over at Oxford to meet one of them.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44838963/0b8aba7bb65478a3431035e0ef3a3d4d4a2e7aa7.png[/img]

Expect an announcement from us Real Soon. Until then, don't let the Draculas bite!

Rest in peace,
The Little Bat Games Team

notes.title: Vampire Therapist: Couples Therapy is ready for love!
notes.notes:
Howdy, cowpokes! We've got a juicy update for you today.

[h1]Couples Therapy DLC Released[/h1]

We're delighted to announce the release of [i]Vampire Therapist: Couples Therapy[/i]! Step back into the spurred boots of Sam Walls, now a vampire therapist extraordinaire, and help an undead couple find peace with one another. We're delighted to bring you more of the award-winning Vampire Therapist world and can't wait to you to sink your teeth into our new adventure!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44838963/3963265ece718d22886f14735399dcc03fcd240a.png[/img]

You'll meet two vampires who died fighting oppression with very different takes on what it means to struggle against entrenched political powers. This, of course, cannot be compared to any modern world events. 

In between sessions, you'll solve a mystery involving the long-dead composer of Leipzig, Johann Sebastian Bach. It's a musical journey you won't want to miss!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44838963/1e43e784eb43b8f05ab1e3d8104287a1c8d0f85f.jpg[/img]

And for those of you who have asked whether Sam will get a chance at love … well, maybe. If you play your cards right.

[h3]Bug fixes[/h3]

We fixed a good number of minor bugs in the game, including character positioning cleanups and correcting some font issues. Now we can properly display French characters!

[h1]Future Plans[/h1]

We're already hard at work on pre-production for our next game, and we can't wait to share more with you. We can promise that there's no game like it already!

We'll also have some exciting Vampire Therapist news in the near future. Keep watching this space and we'll keep you in the loop!

-----------

If you know a content creator who would enjoy playing Vampire Therapist: Couples Therapy, let us know on our discord or just send us an email. We're eager to share our world with anyone who will listen!

We appreciate all your support and hope you'll have tons of fun in couples therapy. Happy Early Valentine's day!

The Little Bat Games Team

notes.title: Free Story Update: Fathoms Below
notes.notes:
Howdy pardners! We've got some fun stuff for ya this month.

[h1]Free Story Update[/h1]

Today we're releasing the last free story update exploring the history of Andromachos, our mentor and hot vampire stereotype.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44838963/f8fa4918fdc52bbee4393fb90e8e20cc02f7c90c.png[/img]

What makes a vampire put meaningless murder behind them? What dark secrets can they learn when they don't need to breathe? And what was the deal with Sigmund Freud and his mother? Find out in this story update, and give an elder vampire an emotional release!

I also fixed a bug where resolutions wouldn't save. I listen!!

[h1]Awards 'n' Honors[/h1]

Little Bat Games is a hyper-tiny studio, with one solo dev and a team of contract artists, editors, and support programmers. But we've been making waves here at the end of the year!

We've picked up an [url=https://indiex.online/]Indie X Award[/url] for Best Game for a Better World and were in their top 5 games among all more than 600 submitted games.

We picked up a [url=https://deutscherentwicklerpreis.de/nominierte-gewinner/]German Developer Prize[/url] for Best Game Beyond Entertainment where we got to get all dressed up and do a speech.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44838963/e8daa8cf9e612f7947a402ad0621f6d5a5c24287.jpg[/img]

And last week, we were added to the [url=https://www.bafta.org/media-centre/press-releases/bafta-announces-2025-bafta-games-awards-longlist]BAFTA Game Awards longlist[/url] in the Best Game Beyond Entertainment category.

We're honored to be contending with big studios when it took us three tries to make curtains work properly!

Your support is hugely helpful right now to give us visibility, so if Vampire Therapist affected you in some way, please share and help us build a groundswell... we still hope to make Vampire Therapist 2 if we can make our money back!

[h1]DLC coming soon[/h1]

Don't forget to wishlist [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3320590/Vampire_Therapist__Couples_Therapy]Vampire Therapist: Couples Therapy[/url]! Ring in 2025 by sorting out our collective resentment over wealth inequality and finding some peace in our relationships.

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3320590/Vampire_Therapist__Couples_Therapy][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44838963/c3a4e2f5abb4b3be8538726f6aa8170aab58a582.png[/img][/url]

When the nights are long, this is the time for vampires to seek love. Maybe even cowboy vampires. 

[h1]Yeah, but what else though?[/h1]

What else?! Well, if you want, you could go play [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1145350/Hades_II/]Hades 2[/url] (I'm back as Dionysus), and we've been consulting with Com8Com1 on [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2747550/Bloodshed/]Bloodshed [/url]for both writing and voiceover. One of the playable characters sounds like Sam might before he found his peace. It's a first person Vampire Survivors boomer shooter with snarky hero quips, just like the 90s used to make, out now in Early Access!

Thank you for coming on this ride with us, and we'll see you cowpokes in 2025!

Love,
Cyrus and the Little Bat Games team

notes.title: The Minigames Patch
notes.notes:
Greetings, dear immortals!

We're going on a much-needed vacation, but we've got a patch for you before we get our not-so-eternal rest.

[h2][h1]Minigames Overhaul[/h1][/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44838963/40b043f3f9b16f9106e8bf0f08bbbb7fdfcb80ac.png[/img]

We got some frequent feedback that our club goths were coming on a little strong. Vampire sexuality is a playful running joke in Vampire Therapist (consent is important!), but it was misread in this case, so we had our friendly bartender cut in a little early.

[h2]Odd and ends[/h2]

* Club sound propagation is corrected in one location
* Character positioning improved during dance scene

[h2]Last Day of Sale[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44838963/638faa7373b8015e9148eac68e587af77f6b2ec8.png[/img]

Today is the last day Vampire Therapist is on sale for spooky season. Please spread the word if Vampire Therapist made you feel a little bit better about the world or yourself! We're a small studio and your support helps us far more than you could imagine.

Happy biting, children of the night!

notes.title: It's Curtains For You
notes.notes:
Greetings, children of the night! 

We've got a special new patch you all today. You know how Vampire Therapist has a reputation as "that really cool and funny game with the wonky curtains?" Well, now the curtains are fixed!

Why did it take this long? Well, Vampire Therapist is largely a solo project and I'm not an experienced programmer. Apparently embedding video with transparency will make most computers melt. So now we use a green screen effect to render the curtains opening and closing instead. Neat!

Further patch notes:

[list]
[*]Updates the curtains to use a greenscreen — should work much better on slower machines!
[*]Ensures players can't save during Distortion picking. Sorry, my dear therapists, have confidence and commit to your choices! 
[*]Lots of setup for upcoming content and upcoming demo
[/list]
That's all this time. Thanks for your patience, bloodsucking buddies!

Love,
Cyrus

Stay tuned for more soon!

Rest in peace,
Little Bat Games

notes.title: Interview with the Vampire Developer: Live Broadcast #2
notes.notes:
Enter the world of Vampire Therapist with its creator, writer and voice actor Cyrus Nemati, as he plays the NextFest demo of this hilarious and heartfelt analyze-'em'-up!

Ask questions, watch sexy vampires, or just have a good time listening to our incredible cast, including [b]Matthew Mercer, Sarah Grayson, Francesca Meaux[/b], and [b]Kylie Clark.[/b]

Vampire Therapist was created in conjunction with licensed therapists and acclaimed historians, and uses real therapy principles. It's not just sexy, blood-drinkin' fun... you'll learn something along the way.

It'll be a bloody good time!

notes.title: Interview with the Vampire Developer: Live Broadcast
notes.notes:
Enter the world of Vampire Therapist with its creator, writer and voice actor Cyrus Nemati, as he plays the NextFest demo of this hilarious and heartfelt analyze-'em'-up!

Ask questions, watch sexy vampires, or just have a good time listening to our incredible cast, including [b]Matthew Mercer, Sarah Grayson, Francesca Meaux[/b], and [b]Kylie Clark.[/b]

Vampire Therapist was created in conjunction with licensed therapists and acclaimed historians, and uses real therapy principles. It's not just sexy, blood-drinkin' fun... you'll learn something along the way.

It'll be a bloody good time!

notes.title: Vampire Therapist is a unique dark comedy narrative adventure with a great voice cast
notes.notes:
Being a Vampire Therapist is not something that's high up on my wishlist of jobs, but it certainly sounds interesting and you can try out the fresh demo now.

Read the full article here: https://www.gamingonlinux.com/2024/06/vampire-therapist-is-a-unique-dark-comedy-narrative-adventure-with-a-great-voice-cast

notes.title: Vampire Therapist Cast Announcement, Demo Release and New Trailer
notes.notes:
Good news, dear mortals! The Nextfest [b]demo[/b] for Vampire Therapist is [b]now live[/b], and that's only the beginning of the bloody exciting news.

We've got a special one for you today! In creating a game where vampires feel all the feelings, we needed a cast of actors with both strong comedic chops and the ability to show some deep, dark emotions, and we attracted the best of the best. 

Check out our new trailer!

[previewyoutube=wqQsV-tMHRA;full][/previewyoutube]

Joining the cast are:

[b]Cyrus Nemati[/b] (Hades/Pyre)
[b]Francesca Meaux [/b](Hades)
[b]Sarah Grayson[/b] (Gone Home, Hades II)
Introducing [b]Kylie Clark[/b] as Isabella d'Este
and [b]Matthew Mercer[/b] (Critical Role, your favorite video games)

We're very excited to reveal that [b]Matthew Mercer[/b] will welcome the player to the dark underworld of a vampire goth club.

Play our demo now and be sure to tell your mortal friends to wishlist Vampire Therapist now!

notes.title: AMA with the Vampire
notes.notes:
We're hard at work polishing up the demo of Vampire Therapist to premiere at [b]Steam NextFest[/b], but in the meantime, we've arranged something very special.

Andromachos is our 3000-year-old vampire therapist in residence, and he's taking questions from mortals on, well, anything. Andromachos is older than many deities, so he's seen the world change a lot in his time. 

With [b]Dracula Day[/b] coming up, we got him to emerge from his coffin to answer questions from mortals about history, the challenges of being undead, and even vampire therapy.* 

[url=https://x.com/littlebatgames]Ask questions on X/Twitter by Tuesday, May 28[/url], and Andromachos will respond in video format.

*Vampire therapy is not the same as mortal therapy, and Andromachos is not a licensed mortal therapist. Answers are not considered professional advice.

notes.title: Upcoming visual novel Vampire Therapist mixes vampires and dark humour with CBT
notes.notes:
As we all know, I like vampire stories, and I like different takes on vampire stories. Yesterday Edwin dangled an upcoming visual novel called Vampire Therapist in front of my nose. I am intrigued, also because I appreciate a Ronseal approach to titles. In Vampire Therapist, out on Steam this June 17th, you play Sam, a vampire who becomes a therapist to other vampires. So the title works twice!

Read more

notes.title: Vampire Therapist is a game about helping the living dead come to terms with their centuries-old emotional hangups
notes.notes: Some game announcements just immediately grab my attention, and Vampire Therapist is definitely one of them. Honestly, it had me at the title—I mean, Vampire Therapist, there's no way you don't want to know more about that—but the underlying concept looks genuinely interesting too: It's a dark comedy narrative adventure about a cowboy who was turned into a vampire in the 1800s and is now seeking help coming to terms with immortality and finding meaning in his unlife... Read more.
